content: RapidFuzz docs (primary): fuzz.ratio = normalized Indel similarity, float 0-100 (difflib SequenceMatcher.ratio is 0-1 matching-blocks based - different algorithm, scores NOT interchangeable; cutoff 0.75 must become ~75 and be re-measured). score_cutoff returns 0 below threshold. partial_ratio/token_sort_ratio/WRatio are different scorers. SIF suggest.py pins deterministic (ratio desc, term asc) tie-break and _hits/_retrievable FTS-probe contracts - a rapidfuzz swap must preserve both and re-validate suggestion output, not just latency.
